dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped light markings on the posterior-dorsal region exhibiting sharp outer-to-inner dark-to-light gradients. Edge perimeters are irregularly elliptical and most defined in the upper-right quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse to moderate distribution of solid high-intensity light-colored pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily localized between the larger annular structures on the posterior flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the upper posterior flank form an obtuse triangle with the longest side extending posteriorly.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical, high-contrast reddish linear lesion or fresh wound is visible on the upper dorsal region toward the anterior end, approximately one-quarter of the length from the left edge.
